summary: Iteration 4 validated the new 'WhatsApp ile Gönder' feature end-to-end: (1) new public no-auth endpoint GET /api/public/quotes/{qid}, (2) new auth endpoint GET /api/customers/{cid}, (3) new public page /q/:id (PublicQuote), (4) whatsapp-quote-button on QuoteView. Backend: 57/57 pytest passed (49 existing + 8 new in TestPublicQuoteAndSingleCustomer covering: single-customer authed 200 with phone, single-customer 401 unauth, no clash between /customers/{cid} and /customers/{cid}/history, public quote 200 no-cookie with quote+company, no _id leaked, 404 on invalid ObjectId and 404 on non-existent id). Frontend E2E: WhatsApp button PRESENT on QuoteView and produces valid wa.me link → https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=905551234567&text=... containing the phone normalized to 90-prefix AND the /q/<qid> public link; missing-phone shows exact toast 'Müşterinin telefon numarası kayıtlı değil'; /q/<validId> in a fresh browser context (3 cookies were session-only, no auth cookies) rendered [data-testid=public-quote] with customer name, item, and grand total without redirect to /login; /q/<badId> shows [data-testid=public-quote-error] 'Teklif bulunamadı'; public-print-button present. Regression: dashboard/stats + monthly-profit + settings all still functional. All test data cleaned; DB verified empty (0 customers/quotes/txns), settings reset to defaults.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 868 lines (>700 guideline); consider splitting into routers/quotes.py, routers/customers.py, routers/public.py, routers/email.py.

GET /api/public/quotes/{qid} correctly wraps ObjectId(qid) in try/except and returns 404 on malformed id; company doc pops _id + key before merge - clean. No sensitive fields (no cost prices etc.) exposed in the quote schema, so public exposure is acceptable.
Route order OK: /customers/{cid}/history and /customers/{cid} coexist because paths differ in segment count - FastAPI matches correctly. Verified by test_single_customer_does_not_clash_with_history.

shareWhatsApp in QuoteView.js: relies on customer state loaded async; if user clicks before /customers/{cid} resolves, the falsy-phone branch fires (toast). This is safe (no crash) but a minor UX nit - could disable button until customer is loaded, or fetch phone inline.
PublicQuote uses same axios instance with withCredentials:true - fine for no-auth endpoint but sends any existing auth cookies (harmless since endpoint has no dependency, still worth noting).

Prior open items still apply: no month-end boundary computed in monthly-profit filter; next_quote_number races via count_documents; add_quote_payment inserts income txn without transaction/rollback; compute_quote_totals VAT applied on pre-discount subtotal (business decision).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 customers (E2E_WAcust w/phone, E2E_NoPhone) + 2 quotes during frontend E2E; leftover TEST_Updated customer + TEST_Kira txn from historic pytest runs also cleaned. Final state verified: 0 customers, 0 quotes, 0 transactions; /api/settings reset to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_rhisos_backend.py now has 57 tests (~7s parallel). New class TestPublicQuoteAndSingleCustomer covers /api/public/quotes/{qid} and /api/customers/{cid}. Frontend selectors of interest for WhatsApp feature: whatsapp-quote-button, public-quote, public-quote-error, public-print-button. To exercise the WhatsApp popup in Playwright, use page.expect_popup() and wait ~2.5s AFTER navigating to /quotes/:id so the async /customers/{customer_id} fetch completes before clicking (otherwise phone is empty and toast error fires).
rca of the issue: N/A - all new features implemented correctly per spec and pass all assertions.
